title: The combined effect of a carbon sleeve and carbon veil as an anode electrode in enhancing microbial fuel cell performance
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,42113-42120
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05180K, Paper

In this study, a novel composite anode electrode for microbial fuel cells (MFCs) was developed by wrapping a carbon sleeve around the surface of a carbon veil.
